comment: SGI presupposes sustained institutional capacity (committees, curation, release management) that is scarcest in the LMICs this guidance most aims to serve. The financing and capacity sections are thin relative to what the governance model demands.

public.text: SGI presupposes sustained institutional capacity (committees, curation, release management) that is scarcest in the LMICs this guidance most aims to serve. The financing and capacity sections are thin relative to what the governance model demands.
public.suggestedRevision: Expand §§4.5–4.6 with a minimal viable SGI staffing/costing model and options for regional pooling of semantic governance (shared curation across countries, as §3.4.6 hints), so the governance burden matches realistic capacity.
